B1/nitrate/Q1.decision_note: inclusive limits applied to the unrounded recovery; display is not used for the decision

B1/nitrate/S1.decision_note: strict > on the unrounded RSD, evaluated exactly; the six-decimal display cannot express a near-tie

intent: Exact concentration is 1.000000099999...e12 mg/L, just above the 1e12 acceptance bound, so the default context must reject the input. A low-precision multiply rounds it to exactly 1e12 and a context-dependent loader silently accepts what the contract forbids.
